calculation_steps: For each ascending edge ij, 1^T B1[:,ij]=-1+1=0. Thus L A=0 on C0+C1+C2+C3.
L(x(0))=1; L(F(x(0)))=2; therefore exp(sA)x(0) != F(x(0)) for every real s.
Check A³=-4A and exp(pi A/4)x=(4x+2Ax+A²x)/4 on this carrier.

counterexamples_and_failures: Equal quadratic stock 5 fails to imply a native endpoint.
A²x has odd coefficients, so quarter-phase state needs denominator 4; an initial attempt to encode it over denominator 2 failed and was corrected.
The candidate hard mask is an extra state type absent from Q169.
